Warranty conditions for household appliances
1. Term: products registered online get 12 extra months of cover (added to the 18 months).
2. Term: defects caused by an unauthorised repair are excluded.
3. Term: defects appearing up to and including the same calendar day 18 months after purchase are covered.
4. Term: proof of purchase is required: a receipt, or the online registration of the product.
5. Term: claims are accepted up to and including 14 days after the defect first appeared.
A claim is covered only if it meets every condition above.
